description: This file defines the ConsulClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements provider configuration for Orleans clustering using Consul, for both silo and client builders.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that configures Orleans clustering providers to use Consul for both silo and client builders.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Consul-based clustering with provided configuration.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to use Consul-based clustering with provided configuration.
